info.title: Apibara Copart & IAAI Vehicle Auction API
info.description:
Structured JSON API for Copart and IAAI vehicle auction data. Search auction vehicles, retrieve VIN and lot details, photos, prices, auction status, sale history, related vehicles, filters, locations, usage information, image proxy responses, and auction-to-port shipping prices.

Canonical public facts: 20M+ lifetime/cumulative indexed auction records (not the retained dataset); 4.5M+ current supported vehicle records; 4,538,613 current vehicle/lot records and 6,578,336 retained historical records (11,116,949 retained in total), measured 2026-11-20T22:00:04Z; approximately 30K+ records added or refreshed daily; supported price/status refresh up to 15 minutes and often sooner; supported live bid refresh about 10–15 seconds. Counts are not unique VINs; field availability and freshness vary by source and lot. Approximately one year of retained Copart and IAA / IAAI auction history. Availability varies by VIN, lot and source; not every vehicle has a complete year of records. A five-year archive is not available.

historicalCoverage.label: Approximately one year of auction history
historicalCoverage.note: Approximately one year of retained Copart and IAA / IAAI auction history. Availability varies by VIN, lot and source; not every vehicle has a complete year of records. A five-year archive is not available.

x-apibara-facts.lifetimeIndexedRecordsMeaning: Lifetime/cumulative records indexed over time; not the current retained dataset and not a unique-VIN or unique-vehicle count.

x-history-coverage.label: Approximately one year of auction history
x-history-coverage.note: Approximately one year of retained Copart and IAA / IAAI auction history. Availability varies by VIN, lot and source; not every vehicle has a complete year of records. A five-year archive is not available.

x-apibara-measurement-provenance.measurement_contract: Current and retained history row counts are exact measured database rows, not unique VINs. Nullable source fields are normal; field-coverage percentages may be sample-based.

get.description: Search and incrementally synchronize normalized Copart and IAAI inventory. Filters are cumulative. Applied filters are echoed in meta.applied_filters; unrecognized query keys are reported in meta.unknown_filters. Use include_total=true only when an exact reconciliation count is required.

parameters.name: s
parameters.description: Search by lot number, VIN, or vehicle title.

parameters.name: lot_status
parameters.description: Lot status filter.

parameters.name: lot_sub_status
parameters.description: Open: future or unscheduled active lots. Live: unended regular lots from 30 minutes before to 24 hours after scheduled start; timed lots within up to 15 minutes before their explicit end. Ended: source-ended markers or elapsed timed deadline. A regular start timestamp never proves the lot finished. Open also includes imported active lots with an unassigned auction date. Their auction_at is null and auction_date_pending is true. Explicit date-range filters exclude unassigned dates.

parameters.name: upcoming
parameters.description: Upcoming selector. all = no restriction; only = only upcoming eligible lots; without = exclude upcoming lots. This does not override Open/Sold state logic.

parameters.name: auction_date_pending
parameters.description: true returns only source listings whose auction date is not yet assigned; false excludes date-pending lots.

parameters.name: updated_within_minutes
parameters.description: Return records whose updated_at changed within the requested number of minutes. Designed for incremental synchronization; combine with cursor pagination and auction filters.

parameters.name: price_min
parameters.description: Minimum price.

parameters.name: price_max
parameters.description: Maximum price.

parameters.name: year_from
parameters.description: Minimum vehicle year.

parameters.name: year_to
parameters.description: Maximum vehicle year.

parameters.name: auction_type
parameters.description: Numeric auction platform filter: 0 = all supported platforms, 1 = Copart, 2 = IAAI. Use either auction_type or platform in the same request.

parameters.name: platform
parameters.description: Readable auction platform filter. Use copart or iaai. Use either platform or auction_type in the same request.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Vehicle type. Multiple values are OR-ed; query-array syntax such as type[]=COUPE&type[]=AUTOMOBILE is supported.

parameters.name: body_style
parameters.description: Filter by vehicle_specs.body_style. Multiple values are OR-ed. Query-array syntax is supported, for example body_style[]=Coupe&body_style[]=Convertible. IAAI uses its VehicleClass value; Copart uses the source-backed Body Style field.

parameters.name: body_type
parameters.description: Compatibility alias for body_style. Multiple values are OR-ed. Prefer body_style for new integrations.

parameters.name: make
parameters.description: Vehicle make.

parameters.name: series
parameters.description: Canonical vehicle series / model family. Examples: BMW Series 3, Mercedes-Benz C-Class, Toyota Camry, Audi A4, Ford F-150. Optional; can be combined with model and generation filters.

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: Vehicle model.

parameters.name: generation_id
parameters.description: Vehicle generation catalog ID. Use /vehicles/filters?make=BMW&model=X5 to discover valid IDs. Multiple IDs are supported.

parameters.name: generation
parameters.description: Human-readable generation alias, for example F15, E70 or G05. generation_id is preferred for stable integrations.

parameters.name: color
parameters.description: Vehicle color. Multiple values are supported.

parameters.name: vin_prefix
parameters.description: Match VINs that start with any supplied prefix (OR). Supports comma-separated values vin_prefix=1,4,5 and array syntax vin_prefix[]=1&vin_prefix[]=4&vin_prefix[]=5. Prefixes consist of 1–3 VIN letters/numbers; at most 20 unique prefixes. Combines with other filters, cursor, and include_total. Prefix does not guarantee manufacturing country.

parameters.name: fuel_type
parameters.description: Normalized fuel type; Hybrid includes source values Hybrid, Electric and Gas Hybrid, Hybrid Engine, and Electric and Diesel Hybrid. Multiple values are supported.

parameters.name: odometer_from
parameters.description: Minimum odometer value in miles. Vehicle responses also include the converted km value.

parameters.name: odometer_to
parameters.description: Maximum odometer value in miles. Vehicle responses also include the converted km value.

parameters.name: engine_size_from
parameters.description: Minimum engine size.

parameters.name: engine_size_to
parameters.description: Maximum engine size.

parameters.name: engine_type
parameters.description: Engine layout. I=inline, V=V engine, W=W engine, B/H=boxer/horizontally opposed. Scalar and repeated-array forms are supported.

parameters.name: transmission
parameters.description: Transmission type. Multiple values are supported.

parameters.name: cylinders
parameters.description: Number of cylinders. Multiple values are supported.

parameters.name: drive_type
parameters.description: Drive type. Multiple values are supported.

parameters.name: run_cond
parameters.description: Source-backed running-condition filter. Multiple values are OR-ed; use both Run & Drive Verified and RUNS AND DRIVES for a combined Copart + IAAI running-vehicle filter.

parameters.name: damage
parameters.description: Damage type. Multiple values are supported.

parameters.name: has_key
parameters.description: Filter vehicles by key availability.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Cursor for pagination.

parameters.name: zip
parameters.description: ZIP code for location-based search.

parameters.name: radius
parameters.description: Search radius around ZIP.

parameters.name: units
parameters.description: Distance units.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Records per vehicle-search page. Default 20. The effective maximum is plan-dependent; public plan entitlements can use maxima of 20, 30 or 40, while approved custom plans may differ. Use the active account entitlement as the runtime source of truth.

parameters.name: include_total
parameters.description: When true, meta.total attempts an exact filtered count. For very large or expensive result sets the safety-bounded count may return null; cursor pagination remains available.

parameters.name: facility_id
parameters.description: Auction facility ID.

parameters.name: loc_state
parameters.description: Auction facility state/region code. Accepts a scalar or repeated/form-style array, e.g. loc_state=FL or loc_state[]=FL.

parameters.name: office_name
parameters.description: Auction office or branch name.

parameters.name: auction_date_from
parameters.description: Auction date from.

parameters.name: auction_date_to
parameters.description: Auction date to.

parameters.name: today_only
parameters.description: Return only vehicles with auctions today.

parameters.name: sale_document_pending
parameters.description: Filter by pending sale document.

parameters.name: sale_document_type
parameters.description: Sale document type.

parameters.name: seller_type
parameters.description: Filter by name-based seller classification, not damage/title heuristics. Missing seller names are unknown and do not match non_insurance. For non_insurance, also provide make, model, facility_id or s with a specific VIN/lot; unscoped searches return 422 selective_filter_required. For a full catalogue, sync and filter known seller types locally.

parameters.name: has_shipping_price
parameters.description: Return only vehicles with shipping price data.

parameters.name: sale_document_name
parameters.description: Exact normalized sale-document name. Obtain values from GET /sale-documents. Matching ignores case, repeated whitespace and parenthesized source state/pending annotations. IAAI reads TitleSaleDoc with optional Brand; Copart uses the document name exposed by the vehicle serializer. Not a substring or vehicle listing-title search. Can combine with platform=copart|iaai and the other search filters. Changing this value starts a new cursor search. Broad or rare-name searches that exceed the query budget return 422 selective_filter_required. Add make/model/facility/date/VIN/lot scope and restart without an old cursor; filter a synchronized inventory locally for complete catalogue filtering.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Optional server-side sorting across the complete filtered result, compatible with cursor pagination. auction_soonest: future assigned auction schedule ascending, id ascending; excludes unscheduled and already-started session dates. Uses ad_timed in Timed mode and the regular auction schedule otherwise. For regular auctions this is the session start, not an exact per-vehicle sale/end time. recently_added: stored record creation time descending, id descending, exposed as added_at. It does not use price/status updated_at. Explicit sort overrides default search, distance and updated-within ordering; those parameters still filter. Keep sort and every filter unchanged on cursor pages. Reset cursor when changing sort.

200.description: Paginated list of vehicle auction records.

400.description: Bad request. One or more parameters are invalid.

429.description: API quota exceeded or rate limit reached.

get.description: Get vehicle auction details by VIN or lot number. Use include=history,vin_lots to embed retained sale history and other known lots for the same VIN in one response. Full vehicle detail pricing.seller_reserve contains source-observed reserve status, optional confirmed price and inferred bid bounds. Unknown or ambiguous Reserve Off will not be presented as an exact reserve price.

parameters.name: slugVin
parameters.description: Vehicle identifier. Accepts a 17-character VIN, canonical lot number, Apibara slug_vin returned by list responses, or an IAAI source stock number in 1110xxxxxxxx form. IAAI 1110xxxxxxxx is normalized to the canonical 8-digit lot number.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: Optionally embed related detail-page data in the same response. Comma-separated values: history adds retained sale-history records across known Copart/IAAI lots for the VIN; vin_lots adds other known auction lots for the same VIN in summary form. Example: include=history,vin_lots.

400.description: Bad request. One or more parameters are invalid.

429.description: API quota exceeded or rate limit reached.

get.description: Aggregate retained positive sold-history prices by make and optional model/year/damage/source/date period. Responses are cached briefly.

Read material Copart and IAAI changes in monotonically increasing sequence order. Persist meta.next_cursor only after your local transaction succeeds, then pass it back as after on the next request. Sequence gaps are valid. Non-material technical null/zero initialization noise is filtered. If a cursor falls outside the retained window, the API returns HTTP 410 cursor_expired instead of silently skipping events. New reserve.changed events carry pricing.seller_reserve.* fields when a source-observed reserve status or inferred threshold changes. Reserve Off alone does not establish a numerical reserve.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Return events with sequence greater than this checkpoint. Start with 0 for the oldest retained event.

parameters.name: include_record
parameters.description: Optional current-record hydration. true/all adds the current full normalized vehicle record to every event where available; created adds it only to lot.created. Sync Center incremental feeds use created to stay self-contained without duplicating large media payloads on every bid/status event.

410.description: The requested checkpoint has expired from the retained replay window.

x-codeSamples.source: curl -H "X-API-Key: YOUR_API_KEY" "https://apibara.tech/api/v1/vehicle-auction/changes?after=0&limit=100"

get.summary: Read observed seller reserve signals for a vehicle
get.description: Returns source-backed reserve price only when explicitly disclosed, otherwise null; observed bid threshold bounds are shown separately and only when confirmed by bid-crossing evidence. Reserve Off may mean the reserve was removed. Include_events=1 adds recent observation history. This endpoint consumes one standard API request.

parameters.name: slugVin
parameters.description: Vehicle VIN, lot number, LOT-IAAI-<lot> or lot slug.

parameters.name: include_events
parameters.description: Include recent reserve observations.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of events.

200.description: Seller reserve status, observed limits and optional events

401.description: API key is missing or invalid

429.description: Plan request quota or rate limit reached

post.summary: Create a five-minute read-only live auction session (Pro and higher)
post.description: Included in active Pro and higher Vehicle Auction Data API plans at no additional monthly charge, with no per-message or live-stream overage fees. Requires X-API-Key. WebSocket events do not count toward monthly REST request quota. 403 plan_not_eligible means the plan does not include streaming; do not retry in a loop. Authenticate to the returned WebSocket URL, wait for ready, then send watch_lot or subscribe. Full protocol: https://apibara.tech/docs/vehicle-auction-live.md

401.description: Missing, invalid or expired API key

403.description: Private beta access is disabled or not granted to this account

get.description: Default/normalized view preserves the shared normalized reference catalog. Use view=variants for distinct original source document variants with platform and state. Optional platform is supported only in variants view. Variants preserve source case, pending/state parentheses and IAAI brands, and do not merge state-specific titles. The catalog covers retained vehicle rows and refreshes daily in the background; it is not a promise of every possible auction title or export/registration eligibility. Missing title-state evidence stays null. Normal API authentication and request limits apply.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Case-insensitive literal substring of a document name. Percent and underscore are literal characters.

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: Alphabetical direction.

parameters.name: view
parameters.description: normalized keeps the legacy shared reference list. variants returns distinct source document names, platform and title-issuing state from a precomputed retained-inventory catalog. No pagination.

parameters.name: platform
parameters.description: Only supported with view=variants. With normalized/default view a nonempty platform returns 422.

200.description: Full or searched catalog; an empty search result is data: [].

403.description: No active vehicle-auction subscription or access not permitted.

422.description: Invalid view/q/order/platform, nonempty platform without view=variants, or unsupported auction_type.

503.description: Initial variants catalog is still building; respect Retry-After.

data.description: Available filter values grouped by filter name.

Vehicle.description: Normalized Copart or IAAI auction vehicle record.

odometer.description: Source-backed odometer readings in miles and kilometres. Missing readings may be null; unknown mileage is not zero.

history.description: Present only when include contains history. Retained sale-history entries for known auction lots of the same VIN.

vin_lots.description: Present only when include contains vin_lots. Other known auction lot records for the same VIN, returned in summary form.

details.description: Source-aware detail metadata. IAAI includes normalized inventory sections; auction_information.prebidInformation.reserveMet is a raw IAAI prebid signal and is not equivalent to Copart seller_reserve_met. Copart includes source-backed sale_status (including ess values such as Minimum Bid) and seller_reserve_met when the Copart source explicitly supplies the flag, plus sanitized bid/yard/media metadata. Null in summary view.

seller.description: Available seller name and name-based classification. Unknown means the source does not supply enough evidence; damage, title and missing valuations do not establish seller type. Name-based classification is inferred, not a verified source category.

added_at.description: When this retained vehicle record was created in our system, in UTC. Not when the source first advertised the vehicle and not its latest price/status update.

state.description: Coarse lifecycle. live means an active session window, not proof this lot is bidding now. finished requires a source-ended marker or elapsed timed deadline; a regular scheduled start alone never proves completion.

last_sold_day.description: Last known sale-outcome day. Placeholder dates before year 2000 are normalized to null.

last_sold_at.description: Exact source-backed sale/outcome observation timestamp when available. Null when only a day-level sale date is known.

outcome_status.description: Explicit normalized outcome only; elapsed time alone is not treated as a sale.

auction_ended_at.description: Best known completed-auction/outcome timestamp. Prefers source-backed sale/outcome evidence; otherwise may use a past scheduled auction timestamp. Never uses a future schedule as an ended timestamp.

outcome_observed_at.description: Timestamp when the current outcome was observed/persisted. Prefers source-backed sale evidence; falls back to the persisted vehicle update timestamp when exact source timing is unavailable.

lot_removed.description: Source/parser evidence that the lot was removed from active inventory.

auction_date_pending.description: True when the imported active lot has no assigned auction date. auction_at and ad are null. Explicit auction-date filters exclude these records.

phase.description: Display lifecycle. The regular LIVE window covers the current North American auction day, with an overnight rollover at 06:00 America/New_York and a maximum age of 24 real hours. Unresolved prior-session lots become unknown / awaiting_result, never an inferred finished sale. Read live_window_expires_at when caching a response.

phase_label.description: Human-readable lifecycle label; applications should localize using phase.

result_confirmed.description: Source-backed outcome/removal evidence is present. An ended marker alone or elapsed timed deadline does not establish a confirmed sale; inspect outcome_status.

is_bidding_now.description: Null when the catalogue cannot establish the active lot. Use fresh authenticated live observations to identify bidding now.

live_window_expires_at.description: UTC deadline of this scheduled LIVE listing window. After expiry, refresh the lot; unresolved regular lots await results. This timestamp does not confirm a sale or an auction outcome.

current_bid_usd.description: Current observed bid. Zero/unavailable source values are normalized to null.

buy_now_usd.description: Buy Now amount; unavailable/zero source placeholders are null.

sale_price_usd.description: Canonical persisted final/approval price when positive; unavailable/zero source placeholders are null.

current_bid_at.description: Source-backed observation timestamp for current_bid_usd when a matching bid event for the current auction cycle was captured. Null when no matching source timestamp exists; never inferred from generic vehicle updated_at.

current_bid2_usd.description: Legacy secondary source bid field. Zero/unavailable values are normalized to null.

last_sold_price_usd.description: Persisted last known positive sale price; unavailable/zero source placeholders are null.

estimated_retail_value_usd.description: Copart Estimated Retail Value (ERV) when the Copart source provides a positive value. Null for IAAI and for Copart records where ERV is unavailable or zero.

estimated_cost.description: Apibara robust historical final-sale estimate. Exact make + model + model year + primary damage Q1-Q3 is the base and fewer than 3 exact final-sale comparables yields null. Copart Sold on Approval / On Approval is excluded. When sufficient final sales exist, engine + mileage-band (or engine-only) market-value refinement adjusts high/low-trim vehicles. The most recent retained non-final bid for the same lot may be exposed as previous_high_bid_usd strictly as context and never changes the Q1-Q3 range or median. Distinct from Copart estimated_retail_value_usd.

reserve_price_usd.description: Exact seller reserve in USD only when explicitly disclosed by an official numeric source. Null when unavailable. Never inferred from current bids or Reserve Off; applies to the latest observed auction cycle.

reserve_off_bid_usd.description: First positive bid captured when IAAI displayed Reserve Off in the latest observed cycle. This is an observed bid, not an exact seller reserve: the seller may have removed the reserve. Null when unavailable.

thumbs_count.description: Total source image count represented by the vehicle media set.

has_360.description: True when IAAI Link360 or Copart copartMedia.views_360 source data is available.

items_count.description: Number of media items returned in this response. Summary view may return fewer items than images_count.

total.description: Exact filtered row count when include_total=true; otherwise null.

total_is_exact.description: True when total was requested and computed exactly.

applied_filters.description: Normalized/requested filters applied to this list query.

unknown_filters.description: Unrecognized query keys. Non-empty means the client sent parameters outside the supported contract.

UsageResponse.description: API usage and plan limit response.

data.description: Usage information returned for the authenticated API key.

VehicleGeneration.description: Resolved vehicle generation metadata when the source vehicle can be matched unambiguously.

VehicleSeries.description: Canonical model-family / series resolved from the generation catalog.

IncludedVinLot.description: Summary-form auction lot for the same VIN. Field availability depends on source and lot state.

VehicleSpecs.description: Normalized vehicle specifications. Field availability varies by auction source and lot.

body_style.description: Normalized body style used by the body_style filter. IAAI uses VehicleClass. Copart primarily uses the source-backed Body Style field; when that source field is missing, a conservative fallback is allowed only from explicit vehicle-type labels that are themselves body categories (for example Sedan, SUV, Coupe, Convertible). Generic AUTOMOBILE is not guessed.

EstimatedCost.description: Apibara robust historical price estimate. The base comparable set uses distinct final sold lots matching exact make + model + model year + primary damage; Copart "Sold on Approval" is excluded because it is a non-final high bid. Base from/to are Q1-Q3 and at least 3 exact final-sale comparables are required. When enough final sales exist for the target engine and mileage band (or engine alone), a market-value multiplier refines the range for high/low trims. The most recent retained non-final high bid from the same lot may be exposed as previous_high_bid_usd for context only; it never changes from, median or to and is never treated as a confirmed sale.

from.description: Lower bound in USD. Starts from the exact-damage Q1 and may be engine/mileage-refined when sufficient final-sale data exists.

to.description: Upper bound in USD. Starts from the exact-damage Q3 and may be engine/mileage-refined when sufficient final-sale data exists. Previous lot bids never extend this bound.

median.description: Central estimate in USD. Starts from the exact-damage median and may be engine/mileage-refined when sufficient final-sale data exists. Previous lot bids never change this value.

sample_count.description: Number of distinct exact make + model + year + primary-damage final sold comparable lots. Copart Sold on Approval is excluded. Estimate is null when fewer than 3 exist.

refinement_method.description: Optional high/low-trim refinement. engine_mileage is preferred when at least 5 final-sale comparables exist in the target engine+mileage band; engine is the fallback when at least 5 engine-matched final sales exist.

refinement_sample_count.description: Number of final-sale comparables behind the engine or engine+mileage refinement; null when no refinement was applied.

engine_size_l.description: Normalized engine displacement used by the refinement, in liters.

mileage_bucket.description: Mileage band considered by the refinement, for example 0-30k or 30-75k. Engine-only fallback may still report the target band.

market_multiplier.description: Median market-value ratio of the selected engine/mileage cohort to the same make+model+year market, applied to the damage-specific base range.

previous_high_bid_usd.description: Most recent retained high bid from the previous non-final auction cycle for the same platform+lot (for example Not Sold or Sold on Approval). This is context only: it does not change from, median or to and is not a confirmed sale price.

terminal.description: True only for terminal outcomes such as sold, not sold or removed.

changed_fields.description: Canonical field paths changed by this event.

record.description: Optional current full normalized vehicle record returned when include_record=true. May be null for deleted records.

SaleDocument.description: Normalized auction sale/title document metadata. issuing_state is the document/title issuer state and is distinct from the auction yard/location state.

raw_name.description: Source-style display label preserving the title issuing state when available.
raw_name.example: FL - Cert Of Title Slvg Rebuildable

issuing_state.description: State that issued the title/document when explicitly supplied by the auction source. This is not the auction yard state.

variant_id.description: Stable original-document variant identifier. Match against GET /sale-documents?view=variants. A new source variant may appear on a vehicle before the next daily catalog refresh.

source_name.description: Stored source document text matching catalog raw_name. Legacy raw_name can be presentation-formatted for Copart, so prefer source_name/variant_id for catalog matching.

value.description: Pass this value as sale_document_name on GET /vehicles.

page_ids.description: All matching reference categories, not eligibility guarantees.

variant_id.description: Stable hash of source platform, raw document text, recognized issuing state and brand.

raw_name.description: Stored source title text, including parentheses/case. Copart td and ts are separate fields: raw_name preserves td text and issuing_state exposes ts. Outer whitespace is trimmed. Not title-cased or expanded from legacy short codes.

name.description: Normalized document name, with optional IAAI brand.

issuing_state.description: Recognized US state/territory or Canadian province/territory code from Copart title-state field or an unambiguous state in IAAI document text. Never inferred from auction yard/location. Unknown or conflicting state annotations remain null.

brand.description: IAAI source brand, retained as a separate variant dimension.

occurrence_count.description: Retained vehicle rows observed during the generation window. Not unique VINs, completed sales or a transactionally frozen current inventory count.

example_lot_id.description: Source lot/stock number; identify it together with platform. A record may change/disappear after generation.

meta.description: Includes view, generated_at, generation_started_at, total, catalog_total, platform_filter_supported, platform, order, scanned_vehicle_rows, rows_with_document and refresh_interval_hours. Counts span the scan window. Only the last completely published catalog is served.

SellerReserve.description: Reserve observations from the latest captured auction cycle for (platform, lot_number). This may be a historical cycle after relisting; inspect cycle_key and observed_at. Copart and IAAI availability differs and values may be null.

price_usd.description: Exact seller reserve in USD only when explicitly disclosed by an official numeric source. Null when unavailable. Never inferred from current bids or Reserve Off; applies to the latest observed auction cycle.

price_is_exact.description: True only when price_usd contains a positive officially disclosed numeric reserve.

price_source.description: Source of the official numeric reserve, otherwise null.

reserve_off_bid_usd.description: First positive bid captured when IAAI displayed Reserve Off in the latest observed cycle. This is an observed bid, not an exact seller reserve: the seller may have removed the reserve. Null when unavailable.

reserve_off_previous_bid_usd.description: Bid immediately before the first captured IAAI Reserve Off observation, when captured. Not an exact reserve.

reserve_off_observed_at.description: UTC observation time of the first captured Reserve Off amount.

inferred_range_usd.description: Observed bid-crossing bound only when validated; never an exact price.

cycle_key.description: Captured auction-cycle identifier. Do not carry a previous cycle's reserve over to a relisted vehicle.

observed_at.description: UTC time of the latest reserve observation.

RateLimitLimit.description: Current short-window request limit when rate limiting applies.

RateLimitRemaining.description: Remaining requests in the current short-window rate-limit bucket.

RetryAfter.description: Seconds before retrying a rate-limited request.

SubscriptionLimit.description: Total subscription request allowance for the active period.

SubscriptionBaseLimit.description: Base subscription request allowance for the active period.

SubscriptionExtraLimit.description: Additional request allowance applied to the active period.

SubscriptionUsed.description: Requests consumed in the active subscription period.

SubscriptionRemaining.description: Requests remaining in the active subscription period.

SubscriptionPeriodStart.description: Start of the active subscription quota period.

SubscriptionPeriodEnd.description: End of the active subscription quota period.

PerPageLimit.description: Effective maximum page size for the authenticated plan/workflow.

Forbidden.description: The authenticated key/plan is not allowed to perform this request.

RateLimited.description: Rate limit or concurrency limit reached.

ServiceUnavailable.description: The service or an upstream dependency is temporarily unavailable.

NotFound.description: Resource not found in the currently available dataset. Does not imply a plan upgrade is required.

example.message: Resource not found in the currently available dataset.

externalDocs.description: Vehicle Auction Data API documentation and AI-readable resources

historicalCoverage.label: Approximately one year of auction history
historicalCoverage.note: Approximately one year of retained Copart and IAA / IAAI auction history. Availability varies by VIN, lot and source; not every vehicle has a complete year of records. A five-year archive is not available.

x-apibara-facts.lifetimeIndexedRecordsMeaning: Lifetime/cumulative records indexed over time; not the current retained dataset and not a unique-VIN or unique-vehicle count.

x-apibara-agentic-access.note: The current Vehicle Auction Data API contract is data-access oriented. Operation-level x-agentic-access is authoritative for agent execution semantics.
